steps.en: The notice stage is reverted after the OIC rejects it
steps.id: Stage notice dikembalikan setelah OIC menolak
steps.why_en: No reject action exists and no automatic stage revert is tied to a court batch.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi tolak dan tidak ada revert stage otomatis yang terikat ke batch court.

steps.en: The court batch number is cleared
steps.why_en: No court batch number field is in use.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada field batch number court yang dipakai.

steps.en: The notice goes back into the eligible pool
steps.id: Notice kembali ke pool notice eligible
steps.why_en: No eligible-pool selection for court applications exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemilihan pool eligible untuk court application.
